dataset: Chennai MTC prepared stop reference data

coordinate_quality_rules.verified_geojson_match: Exact stop ID match after removing the MTC_ prefix; GeoJSON coordinates selected.
coordinate_quality_rules.placeholder_candidate: GTFS coordinate 12.549663, 80.143925; excluded from default map.
coordinate_quality_rules.repeated_coordinate_review: Unmatched stops sharing a coordinate with another unmatched stop; retained but excluded from default map.
coordinate_quality_rules.unique_unmatched_provisional: Unique unmatched GTFS coordinate; retained as provisional map coordinate.

limitations: GTFS and GeoJSON stop coverage is not complete.
Provisional coordinates have not been independently verified.
Repeated coordinates are flagged for review, not declared invalid.
This is static geographic reference data, not live vehicle tracking.
